name: garak per-detector assessment counts
description: Bounded reporting profile of garak detector assessments. Counts apply to a selected probe/detector and evaluator policy; they are not a universal attack-success rate, a project safety certification or an adopted threshold. This is a source-only component capability profile, not a dataset selection, measured result, model or data permission, contract-validity result or deployment gate. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
